mentions.name: BeyondWP
mentions.description: A migration service that helps business owners break free from WordPress and move their sites onto a modern Next.js-powered stack that is faster, lighter weight, and easier for them to manage.
mentions.problem: The WordPress ecosystem has many frustrations and security problems, and WordPress sites are slower, heavier, and harder to manage than modern alternatives.
mentions.audience: Business owners wanting to leave WordPress
mentions.source_excerpt: I started a service to help business owners break free from WordPress on to a more modern Next.js-powered stack that's faster, lighter weight, and easier for them to manage.

evidence.value: I started a service to help business owners break free from WordPress on to a more modern Next.js-powered stack that's faster, lighter weight, and easier for them to manage.
